cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(bot_sdk_isolation LANGUAGES CXX)
if(NOT DEFINED OBCX_TEST_ROOT OR NOT DEFINED OBCX_BOT_SDK_KIND)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "OBCX_TEST_ROOT and OBCX_BOT_SDK_KIND must be specified")
endif()
find_package(obcx-sdk CONFIG REQUIRED)
find_package(GTest REQUIRED)
include(CTest)
include(GoogleTest)

if(OBCX_BOT_SDK_KIND STREQUAL "common")
  set(_target obcx::bot_common_sdk)
  set(_sources ${OBCX_TEST_ROOT}/cpp/bot_common_contract_test.cpp
               ${OBCX_TEST_ROOT}/cpp/bot_ids_test.cpp common_gateway.cpp)
elseif(OBCX_BOT_SDK_KIND STREQUAL "onebot11")
  set(_target obcx::bot_onebot11_sdk)
  set(_sources ${OBCX_TEST_ROOT}/cpp/bot_onebot_contract_test.cpp)
elseif(OBCX_BOT_SDK_KIND STREQUAL "telegram")
  set(_target obcx::bot_telegram_sdk)
  set(_sources ${OBCX_TEST_ROOT}/cpp/bot_telegram_contract_test.cpp
               ${OBCX_TEST_ROOT}/cpp/bot_gateway_media_test.cpp)
else()
  message(FATAL_ERROR "unknown SDK isolation fixture")
endif()
get_target_property(_links ${_target} INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES)
if(_links MATCHES "obcx_core|runtime_objects")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Bot SDK target exposes process runtime implementation")
endif()
add_executable(bot_sdk_contract ${_sources})
# Only test helpers, not the source repository's public/private include tree.
target_include_directories(bot_sdk_contract PRIVATE ${OBCX_TEST_ROOT})
target_link_libraries(bot_sdk_contract PRIVATE ${_target} GTest::gtest_main)
target_compile_definitions(bot_sdk_contract PRIVATE
  OBCX_BOT_GOLDEN_PATH="${OBCX_TEST_ROOT}/fixtures/bot_contract/production-baseline.json")
gtest_discover_tests(bot_sdk_contract)
